prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1281; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection involving your insured. Our client sustained significant injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured for this loss, along with a copy of the declarations page. Please also confirm whether any other coverage, including excess or umbrella coverage, may apply.

Your insured and your company are hereby placed on notice to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes, without limitation, photographs, recorded statements, claim file materials, vehicle data, telematics information, repair records, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or destroyed while this claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
